findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "stream_key" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stream_key, weather, reverse · Private data: plans, plan_claim, model_record, follow, stream_key, follows, unfollow, strategies, price, strategy_quote, operator_link, step_up_receipt, vault_prepare, script_validate, onboard, fund_with_card, forge, replay_record · Public sink: operator_link, step_up_receipt, onboard, draw, film · Destructive: strategies, operator_link, script_rehearse, reverse, studio_move, rehearse, erase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stream_key, weather, reverse · Private data: plans, plan_claim, model_record, follow, stream_key, follows, unfollow, strategies, price, strategy_quote, operator_link, step_up_receipt, vault_prepare, script_validate, onboard, fund_with_card, forge, replay_record · Public sink: operator_link, step_up_receipt, onboard, draw, film · Destructive: strategies, operator_link, script_rehearse, reverse, studio_move, rehearse, erase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
